tools.description: Alias of search_packing_items — suggest gear for a trip by query + tripType/climate. Pass marketplace=amazon.com for United States users (English, USD, amazon.com /dp links); default amazon.se. Without marketplace/country, an en-US Accept-Language selects amazon.com.

tools.name: get_catalog

Pass marketplace=amazon.com for United States users (English, USD, amazon.com /dp links)

tools.description: Resolve an ASIN, pasted Amazon /dp/ URL, or keywords to a buyUrl (product /dp or packing search) on the chosen storefront. tools.name: create_packing_list
tools.description: Create a trip packing list (storefront chosen like the other tools: marketplace → country → en-US Accept-Language → amazon.se). Returns id, editToken, ownerUrl, listUrl, shopUrl, wishlist, storage. Save editToken for add_packing_item. If storage is token, later mutations may return a new id — always

tools.name: create_and_fill
tools.description: One call: create a curated trip packing list and return shopUrl (share link) + ownerUrl. Pass marketplace=amazon.com for United States users (English, USD, amazon.com /dp links); default amazon.se. Without marketplace/country, an en-US Accept-Language selects amazon.com. Preferred agent path: create

tools.name: get_packing_list
tools.description: Fetch a packing list by id. Returns wishlist items with buyUrl/linkType when available, plus ownerUrl, listUrl, shopUrl. OpenAPI: getWishlist.

tools.name: add_packing_item
tools.description: Add an item to a packing list. Requires editToken from create. Body: name/title plus asin, url (pasted /dp), searchKeywords, or catalogId. Token storage may return a new id — update bookmarks. OpenAPI: addWishlistItem.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: resolve_product, add_packing_item · Private data: create_packing_list, add_packing_item · Public sink: create_and_fill.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: resolve_product, add_packing_item · Private data: create_packing_list, add_packing_item · Public sink: create_and_fill

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
